## About

Sravan Kumar Sindhe is a branding and digital consulting partner based in Munich. Former Managing Delivery Architect in Capgemini's Adobe CTO Office practice. Delivery owner from first website through full marketing technology stack. TOGAF-informed methodology scaled for SMEs. Author of MACE (open-source MCP for AEM governance) and designer of PACE (predictive content staging for AI-agent environments). Collaborates with Prof. Dr. Markus Degen on senior EMEA client engagements.

## Services (summary)

Digital foundation (web, email, brand), MarTech and CX advisory, CRM and operating models, analytics with consent, market prep and export desk patterns for B2B clients.
